analysis:
Examined all supplied source, patches and metadata against the indexed model and selected T-041 detail. CoordinatorClientState.swift:248-263 now publishes Autopilot snapshot/inventory under one lock and tracks registered inventory IDs; atomic publication reduces mismatched registration risk, but callers and connection-reset handling are not supplied. ModelAutopilot.swift:31-49,87-163,198-221 adds adoption, placement holds, busy/stall telemetry, disk accounting and optional hold_seconds. ModelAutopilotSnapshot+Decoding.swift:33-69 decodes these optional additions without relaxing existing required fields; this is data representation, not evidence of authorization or resource-policy enforcement. ModelAutopilotBusyReason.swift:6-51 defines reporting vocabularies, not gate or watchdog implementations.
ProviderLoop+Capacity.swift's visible patch adds transition supervision, cached-build sweeping, download-storage refresh and inventory re-registration at head lines 61-81; lines 175-178 conservatively subtract held weights from reclaim credit with underflow protection. No concrete bypass, plaintext/key exposure, billing change or cache-crypto regression is established here. Existing cache advertisement at CoordinatorClientState.swift:388-455 retains runtime-identity gating; T-041's scope/TTL/at-rest controls are not changed in this supplied file.
Integration must inspect the implementations/callers of these new operations: enforce consent and current session/revision before downloads/adoption; retain serving authorization checks across lease expiry (TB-002, TB-011, T-053); enforce hold bounds and safe cancellation/native release before watchdog recovery (T-010, T-028, T-029); verify disk reserve/caps, build verification and safe cache deletion (A-004, T-012, T-016, T-027, T-041). Also verify registration IDs reset per connection and telemetry reaches only intended recipients. These are unresolved contracts, not observed missing controls; no supported finding qualifies within this source scope.
